cards.quote: Fast-forward to the 2012-2013 season, when Patterson's talent caught the attention of Coleraine F.C., a storied association football club based in Coleraine, County Londonderry. Founded in 1927, Coleraine F.C. had a rich history of producing talented players and competing at the highest levels of Northern Irish football. The club's scouts saw something special in Patterson, and they knew he would be a valuable addition to their squad. On August 11, 2012, Patterson put pen to paper, signing a contract with Coleraine F.C. that would change the trajectory of his career. The news sent shockwaves through the Northern Irish football community, with fans and pundits alike eager to see how the talented forward would fare in the NIFL Premiership, the top division of Northern Irish football. As Patterson donned the Coleraine F.C. jersey, he quickly became an integral part of the team. His pace, skill, and clinical finishing ability made him a nightmare for opposing defenders. In his debut season, Patterson scored 12 goals in 34 appearances, helping Coleraine F.C.
